# Learn the Seerah

> Learn the Seerah is a free, browser-based app for learning the life of the Prophet Muhammad, peace be upon him, through the Seerah Song by Zain Bikha. Made by Ummah Apps. URL: https://seerah.ummahapps.ai/

## What it does

- The front page has a card for each part of the app: The Seerah Song (with the lines learnt and the streak); an Arabic Seerah poem, Manzumat al-Munirah fi Muhimm 'Ilm as-Sirah (مَنْظُومَةُ الْمُنِيرَةِ فِي مُهِمِّ عِلْمِ السِّيرَةِ), a short poem by Shaykh Dr Salih al-Usaymi, as a YouTube playlist; and books to read more: When the Moon Split (the full story of the Seerah) and Shama’il at-Tirmidhi (the Prophet’s character and appearance, peace be upon him), as PDF downloads.
- The Seerah Song page has today’s practice, the choruses to repeat, the 10 sections and the whole song.
- Plays the song line by line, section by section, or as a whole.
- Repeat a line as many times as you like, or slow it down.
- Follow the lyrics and star each line you learn. Stars are saved in the browser on your device.
- Free, with no sign-up.

## Links
